caveat: Confirmation across references is not a detection. Every pairing shares the same unvalidated bandpass transfer, so a genuine colour difference would appear in all of them and be confirmed here. What this removes is the larger population of per-reference artefacts.
onSourceExcluded: Only off-source peaks are cross-matched. A peak on a bright source is a PSF-match residual that appears in every pairing by construction, so confirming one would mean nothing.
